name: Centum Business Hotel
detail: The hotel front desk speaks Chinese and also provides breakfast from the Mama Buffet on the third floor! It's only a bit over 200 for one night, where can you find such a good deal? It's perfect for one person, but may be a bit cramped for two. The room is overall quite tidy, and it's about a 300-meter walk from Centum City subway station, exit 11. It's within walking distance to Shinsegae Department Store, and there's a GS25 convenience store downstairs. I will choose this place again when I come to Busan next time.

name: Lala Vianco Business Hotel
detail: A couple's retirement trip. On our return from Vietnam, instead of just a transit, we decided to spend a night in Busan. The hotel was recommended by a YouTuber who often shares about Busan travel. It's not a large hotel, but it's about the size of a Japanese business hotel, and the room was wonderful, clean, and had thoughtful touches throughout. It's a 5-minute walk from Seomyeon Station and close to Lotte Department Store, markets, and restaurant streets; the location is excellent. There were also many bars nearby, but at a supermarket just a 2-minute walk away, we could buy souvenirs like snacks and Korean seaweed at a pretty good price. Above all, during check-in, the receptionist (who I believe was a Japanese woman) provided polite and friendly explanations in Japanese. They offered a complimentary breakfast of just bread and coffee, and there was even a washing machine in the basement. This hotel is highly recommended for those who want a budget-friendly experience, feeling local life rather than staying in a luxury five-star hotel.

name: Elmomento Songdo Residence
detail: The location is right in the apartment building directly opposite the Matsushima cable car station. Going downstairs not only leads directly to the coastal walkway and beach, but also to convenience stores, coffee shops, barbecue restaurants, sashimi shops, shellfish grill shops, fried chicken shops, and photo-taking shops, all of which have great food options. Overall, except for being very far from Haeundae, the cost-performance ratio is excellent. 👍👍👍 However, there are significant shortcomings in the basic living facilities. Firstly, the bedding is very uncomfortable; the pillows are hard to tolerate, and after one night, I woke up with a stiff neck and my shoulders completely tense. Additionally, the mattress is covered with a waterproof cover before the sheets, which makes it very non-breathable. After a night, my back was soaked with sweat, even though the air conditioning worked very well and it wasn't hot at all. Secondly, there’s a problem with the curtains; the curtains in the room are not blackout curtains, so the moonlight can come in directly at night, and in the morning after sunrise, it becomes extremely bright. Lastly, there's the issue of water pressure while showering; our room is on the fifth floor, and the water pressure is already quite low, making it just barely sufficient to finish a shower but without the relaxing feel of a good shower. Although the suite is quite spacious, with a dedicated walk-in closet, and the kitchen and bathroom facilities are quite good, even equipped with a curling iron, the view from the balcony is also particularly nice, and the windows have double-layer soundproofing, which is excellent; the shortcomings in basic bedding facilities significantly reduce the overall living experience! I hope the host can pay attention to and improve this. 🤗

name: Gwangalli Moon Bay Hotel
detail: It is located right in front of Gwangalli Beach, so the location is amazing. The owner at the front desk is also very friendly. The accommodation is in a great area, so most of the hot spots in Gwangalli are within a 10-minute walk, which was nice. I booked a deluxe room, but they even upgraded me to a premium room for free. The breakfast was also provided for free, which was great. There’s a space on the first floor of the hotel where you can easily wash off sand, which was a huge advantage since you can play on the beach and then wash off before going in. When I entered the premium room, I was surprised at how large the bathroom was compared to most hotel rooms, and there were two showerheads, making it very convenient. The bathtub was huge, able to fit around 3 to 4 people, which was more than enough for two people to enjoy. Thanks to this hotel, I had a truly great experience and I highly recommend it.

name: WResidenceHotelHaeundae
detail: The location is very convenient, as it is almost directly connected to Haeundae Station. The room was spacious, with a desk and a table, making it easy to use for anything. Both the bathroom and the room were very clean, allowing for a relaxing stay. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything necessary, including a microwave, which was very helpful. The beach was visible from the window, and the night view was beautiful. I stayed for four nights this time, but I would like to use it for a long-term stay again. The staff were kind and helped me with various things since I couldn't understand Korean. The front desk is open from 9 AM, so if you plan to check out early in the morning and have matters to attend to at the front desk, it’s best to take care of them the day before for peace of mind.

name: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE HOTELS
detail: This hotel is located right in front of Haeundae Beach, making it easy to access the sea. We were also traveling on foot, and it was convenient to take the bus from the nearby stop to Busan Station. It's positioned between Busan Blue Rail and Dongbaek Island, making it easy to visit both places. Of course, there were also good restaurants nearby. The accommodation was clean, the bedding was fresh, and the mattress provided just the right amount of cushion for a comfortable rest. The bathroom was conveniently separated into a toilet, sink, and shower area. Unfortunately, we did not take advantage of the breakfast, but considering the local prices, I thought the breakfast cost was reasonable. This hotel has an infinity pool on the rooftop, where you can see the sea from the pool, which was also clean and heated, allowing us to have a great time. I forgot to bring a swim cap, but they offered free rentals. There was a locker room, which made it easy to store our luggage after checking out. The detailed service and management were very satisfactory. If I revisit Haeundae next time, I will stay here again.

name: Centum Premier Hotel
detail: I called several times with questions regarding my stay, and I really appreciate the always friendly and precise responses I received. The hotel's location is also great, as it's near a subway station, and there are plenty of restaurants and convenience facilities clustered around Centum City Station. The hotel is completely new, the room is very clean, the bedding is perfectly maintained, and the bathroom is very clean and nice. I heard that other accommodations had to cancel due to the BTS concert and were charging exorbitant rates, but at Centum Premier Hotel, I was treated well with reasonable prices and friendly service. I plan to come back to Centum Premier again next time. I highly recommend it.

name: Urbanstay Seomyeon
detail: I stayed for three nights alone. Good points → It’s right by exit 12 of Seomyeon Station, there’s a convenience store on the first floor with a wowpass machine, and the self-checkout is easy to use. You can leave your luggage after checkout, there’s a kitchen and plates in the room, a desk and chair make it easy to live, there’s a washbasin, a full-length mirror, ample space for a suitcase, and plenty of towels provided. There’s also a washing machine for laundry. Online check-in means no face-to-face interaction with hotel staff, and if anything comes up, they reply quickly when contacted. Bad points → The toilet does not flush toilet paper, and the toilet and shower space are together without a shower curtain, so the toilet does get wet, though not as much as I expected. It was disappointing that the air conditioner was moldy; I hardly used it because of that. There was a moldy smell, and when I turned on the air conditioner, I could see the mold visibly. Overall, it was a good hotel, so I would like to stay again if I’m alone!

name: NOMADX Stay Hostel
detail: This time I chose a single room, and there are a lot of compartments in the room for placing items. Each room has an independent password lock, so even if you go out, the power won't cut off. The capsule dormitory also has individual doors with password locks for each compartment, and I feel that the soundproofing won't be too bad. There are about six restrooms and six shower rooms for females, all very clean. I also didn't encounter any waiting situations. The common lounge area is very spacious; you can choose to work alone here or meet some friends from other places. A simple breakfast in a European and American style is provided from 8 to 10 in the morning, including bread slices, cereal, and coffee. The staff here comes from all over the world, and many are traveling while working. They are always willing to help. Overall, it was a very satisfying accommodation experience, and if I travel to Busan alone again next time, I would still consider staying here!

name: MOOGM Gwangalli - Female-only Dormitory
detail: I booked this place while searching for accommodation in Busan. I arrived earlier than the check-in time, but they kindly took care of my luggage, allowing me to start my trip comfortably. The accommodation is very close to Gwangalli Beach, making the location really good, and it's easy to find for first-time visitors. I didn't have high expectations due to the low price when making the reservation, but it turned out to be better than expected. The hotel was very clean, the room was in good condition, and there was a window, so it wasn't stuffy and was pleasant. Thanks to that, my trip to Busan became even more enjoyable and left me with special memories. If I come to Busan again, I would love to stay at this accommodation again. 😊
